archetypes.name: dyn-check-routing
archetypes.rationale: Relevant-check routing changed path matching and overlapping rule expectations.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changes to python/larch/implement/checks.py and python/test_checks.py. Focus on whether segment-aware glob matching preserves intended direct-target routing, especially for ** patterns and existing broad Python/skill rules. Verify the chronic-surface table asserts full unions rather than one matching row. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-report-gantt
archetypes.rationale: Final-report and progress-report tests now pin Gantt timing output end to end.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new Gantt, progress report, and final report tests. Focus on whether the fixtures exercise the real render_implement_review_detail path and cannot pass vacuously without timing ledger, round metadata, and overlapping vendor rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-aggregate-validator

archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new review_aggregate tests for missing reviewer slots and semantic rejection. Focus on whether they assert the intended validation class without duplicating large fixtures or masking the existing end-to-end fallback behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
